This 2022 Ford F-150 Lariat 4X4 SuperCrew combines a 2.7L EcoBoost engine with an electronic 10-speed automatic transmission. Its 145-inch wheelbase, Trailer Tow Package, 3.55 electronic-locking rear axle and 6,600-lb GVWR Package provide a versatile configuration for work, recreation and everyday driving.

Comfort & Convenience

The cabin includes dual-zone electronic climate control, a heated steering wheel, power driver and passenger lumbar adjustments, power-adjustable pedals with memory and a universal garage door opener. Remote vehicle start is especially useful during Alberta's colder months, while Intelligent Access with push-button start makes daily use more convenient.

A Twin Panel Moonroof brings additional light into the SuperCrew cabin. The power-sliding rear window features both a defroster and privacy tint.

This 2022 Ford F-150 Lariat 4X4 SuperCrew combines a 2.7L EcoBoost engine with an electronic 10-speed automatic transmission. Its 145-inch wheelbase, Trailer Tow Package, 3.55 electronic-locking rear axle and 6,600-lb GVWR Package provide a versatile configuration for work, recreation and everyday driving.

Agate Black Metallic paint complements a Black interior with leather-trimmed bucket seats and a centre console. The Lariat Sport Package, 20-inch six-spoke dark alloy wheels and 275/60R20 all-terrain tires give the truck a clean, confident appearance.

Comfort & Convenience

The cabin includes dual-zone electronic climate control, a heated steering wheel, power driver and passenger lumbar adjustments, power-adjustable pedals with memory and a universal garage door opener. Remote vehicle start is especially useful during Alberta's colder months, while Intelligent Access with push-button start makes daily use more convenient.

A Twin Panel Moonroof brings additional light into the SuperCrew cabin. The power-sliding rear window features both a defroster and privacy tint.

Technology & Practicality

SYNC 4 with a 12-inch touchscreen and AppLink places key connectivity functions within easy reach. This F-150 also features a 12-inch productivity screen, B&O audio system, wireless charging pad, SiriusXM with 360L and Connected Built-In Navigation with three-year service included.

The power tailgate and integrated tailgate step simplify access to the cargo box. BoxLink cargo management, LED box lighting, tie-down hooks and a 136-litre/36-gallon fuel tank add everyday utility.

Capability & Safety

The FX4 Off-Road Package includes skid plates, while the Trailer Tow Package, electronic-locking rear axle and all-terrain tires support a range of truck-focused uses. Tow hooks, zone lighting and a fully boxed steel frame are also included.

Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 is joined by BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane-Keeping System, Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Reverse Brake Assist, a rear-view camera and a Reverse Sensing System. Roll Stability Control and a tire-pressure monitoring system provide additional driver information and support.

Shoppers considering full-size pickups such as the Ram 1500, Chevrolet Silverado 1500 or Toyota Tundra may also want to explore this well-equipped F-150 Lariat configuration.

This 2022 Ford F-150 Lariat 4X4 SuperCrew combines a 2.7L EcoBoost engine with an electronic 10-speed automatic transmission. Its 145-inch wheelbase, Trailer Tow Package, 3.55 electronic-locking rear axle and 6,600-lb GVWR Package provide a versatile configuration for work, recreation and everyday driving.

Agate Black Metallic paint complements a Black interior with leather-trimmed bucket seats and a centre console. The Lariat Sport Package, 20-inch six-spoke dark alloy wheels and 275/60R20 all-terrain tires give the truck a clean, confident appearance.

Comfort & Convenience

The cabin includes dual-zone electronic climate control, a heated steering wheel, power driver and passenger lumbar adjustments, power-adjustable pedals with memory and a universal garage door opener. Remote vehicle start is especially useful during Alberta's colder months, while Intelligent Access with push-button start makes daily use more convenient.

A Twin Panel Moonroof brings additional light into the SuperCrew cabin. The power-sliding rear window features both a defroster and privacy tint.

Technology & Practicality

SYNC 4 with a 12-inch touchscreen and AppLink places key connectivity functions within easy reach. This F-150 also features a 12-inch productivity screen, B&O audio system, wireless charging pad, SiriusXM with 360L and Connected Built-In Navigation with three-year service included.

The power tailgate and integrated tailgate step simplify access to the cargo box. BoxLink cargo management, LED box lighting, tie-down hooks and a 136-litre/36-gallon fuel tank add everyday utility.

Capability & Safety

The FX4 Off-Road Package includes skid plates, while the Trailer Tow Package, electronic-locking rear axle and all-terrain tires support a range of truck-focused uses. Tow hooks, zone lighting and a fully boxed steel frame are also included.

Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 is joined by BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert, Lane-Keeping System, Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Reverse Brake Assist, a rear-view camera and a Reverse Sensing System. Roll Stability Control and a tire-pressure monitoring system provide additional driver information and support.

Shoppers considering full-size pickups such as the Ram 1500, Chevrolet Silverado 1500 or Toyota Tundra may also want to explore this well-equipped F-150 Lariat configuration.
